# Backup of the previous Terbium workflow.
# Rename this file to deploy-terbium.yml (and remove deploy.yml) to restore Terbium.

name: Deploy Terbium to GitHub Pages (disabled)

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "22"

      - name: Fetch Terbium source
        run: git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/TerbiumOS/web-v2.git app

      - name: Build static site
        working-directory: app
        run: |
          npm i --no-audit --no-fund
          npm run build-static
          touch dist/.nojekyll

      - name: Make the first screen appear sooner
        working-directory: app
        run: |
          cat > speedup.py <<'PY'
          import re, sys, pathlib
          dist = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
          page = dist / "index.html"
          html = page.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
          html = re.sub(r"\s*<!--\s*Google tag \(gtag\.js\)\s*-->", "", html)
          html = re.sub(r'\s*<script[^>]*googletagmanager\.com[^>]*>\s*</script>', "", html)
          html = re.sub(r"\s*<script>\s*window\.dataLayer.*?</script>", "", html, flags=re.S)
          page.write_text(html, encoding="utf-8")
          PY
          python3 speedup.py dist

      - uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with:
          path: app/dist

  deploy:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    steps:
      - id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4
